Description.SourceString:
Requisition Request: 1 Penguin Cape.

Reasoning: The humans seem to have a fascination with flappy cloth on their back. For full assimilation into human society, our own cape is requested. Ideally, it should have some form of special effect. If that is not possible, all cape-bearing penguins must shout "I have activated my special effect" and "ooh, that special effect really saved me there" on rotation. This is imperative.

Strozzapretti has done her homework, and has reported that the capes also confer status on the owner. Those who wear capes demand more respect from their human brethren. I have asked her to experiment with wearing two capes to see if the effect is doubled. She is to report back tomorrow.
